policy.lsmr: Exactly two or three categorical intercept FE dimensions, fast-memory execution, and complete ordinary/checkpoint workspace admitted before construction.
policy.map: All other cases, low memory, allocation audit, or modeled specialized-workspace veto.
policy.actual_allocation_error: Fatal; not an admission veto or numerical fallback.

science.objective: Finite, valid, independently Poisson-identity-consistent reported reference pair; candidate no worse under ADR 0026.

repair_validation.scope: Complete baseline coverage plus targeted common-repair validation, not an all-scope repaired-source rerun.

limitations: Development admission only: no formal cross-platform, Windows, release or performance qualification is asserted.
Complete reference records recovered from failed campaigns are prospective scientific witnesses under preserved input/reference context, not sealed per-fit provenance or accepted timings.
Four strict reference attempts timed out; none is reclassified as a successful fit or numerical reference error.
Reference predicted-state diagnostics unavailable from incomplete runs remain unavailable; no predicted or projected state is used as an additional objective witness.
No source revision inherits a historical campaign's pass; each baseline, repair and local artifact retains its own identity.
